Lemma
[Ricci contraction of a wedge] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0112 ↗ def:chow-ii-symmetric-endomorphism-wedge ↗ def:chow-ii-algebraic-ricci-contraction 1. ch11:11.14\group Algebraic Curvature Operators If $A,B\in S^2(E)$, then \[ \operatorname {Rc}(A\wedge B) =\frac12\{ A(\operatorname {tr}(B)\operatorname {id}-B) +B(\operatorname {tr}(A)\operatorname {id}-A)\} . \] In particular, $\operatorname {Rc}(A\wedge A)=\operatorname {tr}(A)A-A^2$ and $\operatorname {Rc}(A\wedge \operatorname {id}) =\tfrac {n-2}{2}A+\tfrac {\operatorname {tr}(A)}2\operatorname {id}$.
Proof

\sketch Contract the first and third indices in the component formula of 3. The four resulting terms are respectively $A\operatorname {tr}(B)$, $-AB$, $B\operatorname {tr}(A)$, and $-BA$, with the common factor $1/2$. The special cases follow by substitution.
